Subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — next steps on Redwood for FinTechX

Hi Sophie —

Really enjoyed meeting you and Alex at the Inference Summit yesterday. Quick recap from our conversation and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Highlights from the call:
- Primary need: reduce per-request latency for authorization and risk scoring flows (p95 target < 120ms)
- Volume profile: bursts up to ~200 RPS during peak batch runs; steady background of 20–30 RPS
- Constraint: PCI-adjacent data, so data residency + audit logs are must-haves
- Success metric: equivalent or better latency than current internal model at 30–40% lower inference cost

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) 2-week POC — integrate Redwood Hosted endpoint with a small sandbox of your scoring traffic (we provide a baseline config and batching recommendations)
2) Security/compliance review — provide SOC 2 artefacts and an initial network readout (we can run in your VPC if needed)
3) Pricing/ops sync — Rishi will scope cost estimates and options for Dedicated capacity if POC looks promising

I attached a short proposal and a simple cost-model workbook to help you validate key assumptions. Can we lock a 30-minute follow-up demo next week (demo + quick config walkthrough)? Here are a few times I have available: Tue 5/25 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 5/26 13:00–14:00 PT, Thu 5/27 09:00–10:00 PT.

Attachments: Redwood_Intro_Proposal_FinTechX.pdf, inference-cost-models.xlsx

Thanks again for your time — happy to adjust based on your calendar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Just wanted to bump this thread in case my note from 5/20 got buried after the conference. Quick check: is this still a priority for FinTechX in the next 4–6 weeks? If timing has shifted, no problem — happy to align to your schedule.

If it is still on the roadmap, we can do either:
- A compact 2-week proof-of-concept (we'll provide a sandbox endpoint + configs)
- Or a design/requirements sync with your platform team (30–45 min) if you want to scope Dedicated capacity early

I can also loop in Rishi for a short pricing primer if that would be helpful. Do any of these times work for you next week: Mon 6/7 11:00–11:30 PT, Tue 6/8 14:00–14:30 PT, Wed 6/9 09:30–10:00 PT?

If now isn't the right time, a quick reply with the expected quarter (e.g., Q3) would be super helpful so we don't keep pinging.

Thanks — hope things are going well at FinTechX.
